description: Galbi Korean BBQ Short Ribs are a beloved staple, featuring tender, flavorful beef short ribs marinated in a rich, sweet-savory sauce. This classic dish promises a delightful grilling experience and an unforgettable taste of authentic Korean cuisine, perfect for sharing with family and friends.

instructions.title: Prepare the Short Ribs
instructions.text: Rinse the flanken-cut short ribs under cold water and pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels. This helps the marinade adhere better and prevents excess moisture from steaming the ribs during grilling. Lay them flat on a baking sheet.

instructions.title: Make the Galbi Marinade
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the soy sauce, water, brown sugar, sesame oil, minced garlic, grated ginger, grated Asian pear, grated onion, and black pepper. Whisk all ingredients together until the sugar is fully dissolved and the marinade is well combined. The pear and onion contribute natural sweetness and tenderizing enzymes.

instructions.title: Marinate the Short Ribs
instructions.text: Place the prepared short ribs into the bowl with the marinade, ensuring each piece is fully coated. You can also use a large zip-top bag for this step. Cover the bowl or seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, to allow the flavors to deeply penetrate the meat.

instructions.title: Preheat Your Grill
instructions.text: About 20-30 minutes before you plan to cook, preheat your gas or charcoal grill to medium-high heat. The ideal temperature for Galbi is around 400-450F (200-230C). Lightly oil the grill grates to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Grill the Galbi
instructions.text: Remove the ribs from the marinade, letting any excess drip off. Discard the remaining marinade. Place the ribs on the preheated grill. Cook for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness and desired doneness, flipping occasionally. Look for a beautiful caramelization and slight char.

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Once cooked to your liking, remove the Galbi from the grill and let them rest on a cutting board for 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute, ensuring tender and flavorful ribs. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced green onions before serving immediately.

tips: For extra tender ribs, score the surface of the meat lightly before marinating, being careful not to cut through the bone. This helps the marinade penetrate deeper.
If you cant find Asian pear, a ripe Bosc pear or even a small apple can be used as a substitute for the natural sweetness and tenderizing enzymes.
Serve Galbi with a side of steamed white rice, fresh lettuce wraps, kimchi, and other banchan (small side dishes) for a complete Korean dining experience.
article:
Korean cuisine is celebrated worldwide for its vibrant flavors and the communal joy it brings to the dining table. Among its many iconic dishes, one stands out as a true masterpiece: Galbi. These succulent, marinated short ribs are a cornerstone of Korean BBQ, offering a perfect blend of sweet, savory, and umami notes that dance on your palate. If you've ever dreamt of recreating an authentic Korean dinner experience at home, mastering the art of Galbi Korean BBQ Short Ribs is an excellent place to start. This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you need to know to prepare this beloved dish, transforming your kitchen into a Korean BBQ haven.

## What is Galbi Korean BBQ Short Ribs?
Galbi, literally meaning "rib" in Korean, refers to a dish made with marinated and grilled beef short ribs. It is arguably one of the most popular and cherished Korean dinner recipes, often served at celebratory gatherings and family meals. What sets Galbi apart is its unique cut of meat and the deeply flavorful marinade. Traditionally, Galbi is prepared using flanken-cut beef short ribs, which are cut across the bone into thin, wide strips. This particular cut ensures the meat cooks quickly and absorbs the marinade beautifully, resulting in incredibly tender and juicy ribs. The bones contribute significantly to the depth of flavor during cooking. While beef Galbi is the most common, pork Galbi (Dwaeji Galbi) is also a popular variation. The allure of Galbi Korean BBQ Short Ribs lies in its exquisite balance of flavors – a symphony of soy sauce, garlic, sesame oil, and often a touch of fruit like Asian pear or apple, which acts as a natural tenderizer and adds a subtle sweetness.

## Ingredients You Need for Galbi
To embark on your Galbi journey, you’ll need a selection of fresh ingredients for both the meat and its iconic marinade. The quality of your ingredients directly impacts the final flavor, so opt for the best you can find.

For the Ribs:
*   2-3 lbs beef short ribs, flanken-cut (about 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick)

For the Marinade:
*   1/2 cup soy sauce (low sodium preferred)
*   1/4 cup brown sugar (packed)
*   2 tablespoons mirin (rice wine)
*   2 tablespoons sesame oil
*   2 tablespoons minced garlic
*   1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger
*   1/2 medium Asian pear, grated (or 1 small apple, grated)
*   1/4 cup water or beef broth
*   1/2 medium onion, grated or finely pureed
*   1 tablespoon black pepper

Optional Garnishes:
*   Toasted sesame seeds
*   Sliced green onions
*   Red chili threads (실고추, silgochu)

Ensure your short ribs are thawed if frozen. If you can't find flanken-cut ribs, you can ask your butcher to cut them for you. The Asian pear is a crucial ingredient, not just for its sweetness but for its enzymes which tenderize the meat beautifully.

## Step-by-Step Instructions for Galbi
Preparing delicious Galbi Korean BBQ Short Ribs at home is a rewarding process that begins with the marinade and ends with perfectly grilled meat. Follow these steps for an unforgettable meal:
